cross_module_invariants: N00 policy is enforced by server-side gates; UI visibility is not authority.
N02 owns command/state transitions and idempotency; N03 persists authoritative state and audit evidence.
N04 binds authenticated users to exact candidate records; never infer identity from email alone.
N05 document signature validation is not malware scanning; release remains gated until scanning/quarantine evidence exists.
N07 is a mirror/adapter, not the authoritative truth store.
N10 verified financial events, not order existence alone, gate downstream service fulfilment.
N11 recommendations do not replace authorised human decisions.
N16 workers execute only policy-approved, authorised work.
N20 must block production readiness when critical evidence is missing.
release_rule: productionReady=false until all required evidence for the target environment is verified and approved.
